about: Step 8g, descriptive only (28 October 2026): nothing here may be used to change a rule, threshold, label or entry on the dev set. Inputs: k5_{question,full}_relabelled.json and k5_baseline21_relabelled.json (cff6009), the relabelled dev labels (outside the repository), V3 /classify, and offline rankings with ml_service's KnowledgeBaseRetriever (they reproduce the saved unscoped top-1 and served entry for every question). Pass on 21 = the 21-entry replies (K3 Before) scored on the relabelled labels. Causes: a = a new entry in the same class outranks the acceptable one; b = scoping sent it to the wrong class; c = the gate abstained though an acceptable entry was on top; d = the acceptable entry changed id or text between the KBs; e = other. Near duplicates: cosine of question embeddings ('query: ' prefix both sides); 'within 0.03' read as cosine >= 0.97, and also as the self-retrieval near-miss margin (own entry top-1 by less than 0.03, unscoped).
